map.支持体积和材积重估算，适用于物流报价。: Supports volume and volumetric weight estimation, suitable for logistics quoting.
map.体积(cm³) = 长 × 宽 × 高，体积(m³) = 立方厘米 ÷ 1,00: Volume (cm³) = length × width × height, volume (m³) = cubic centimeters ÷ 1,000,000; volumetric weight (kg) = length × width × height ÷ volumetric divisor (6000 is common for air, 8000 for road express); chargeable weight = max(actual weight, volumetric weight); loading rate = cargo volume ÷ container volume × 100%; for container estimates (20-foot about 33 m³, 40-foot about 67 m³), container load count = container volume ÷ single box outer volume.
map.📚 深度解析：包装材积与抛重换算: 📚 Deep dive: Package Volume and Volumetric Weight Conversion
map.发货前按长×宽×高算体积与抛重，判断会不会按体积重计费。: Before shipping, compute volume and volumetric weight from length × width × height to judge whether billing will use volumetric weight.
map.优化包装：比较不同箱型的抛重，选运费最低的尺寸。: Optimize packaging: compare the volumetric weight of different box types and pick the size with the lowest freight.
map.整批发货时把多件尺寸累加，估算总体积以便订舱或叫车。: For a whole batch, add up the dimensions of many items to estimate total volume for booking space or calling a truck.
map.50×40×30 cm 箱子的抛重: Volumetric weight of a 50×40×30 cm box
map.体积 = 50×40×30 = 60 000 cm³ = 0.0600 m³。抛: Volume = 50×40×30 = 60 000 cm³ = 0.0600 m³. At a divisor of 6000 the volumetric weight = 60 000 ÷ 6000 = 10.00 kg; at 5000 it is 12.00 kg. If the actual weight is only 8 kg, a carrier using 6000 bills by 10 kg, which is 2 kg more than actual; compressing the height to 24 cm (volume 48 000 cm³) drops the volumetric weight to 8.00 kg, so billing follows actual weight.
map.国内快递常见 6000 或 8000，国际快递（DHL/UPS/FedEx）多为: Domestic express commonly uses 6000 or 8000; international express (DHL/UPS/FedEx) mostly 5000; air freight commonly 6000. Defer to the carrier's published rules, since a wrong entry skews the chargeable weight.
map.材积重大于实重怎么办？: What if the volumetric weight exceeds actual weight?
map.按较大者计费。可压缩包装尺寸（尤其高度）、改用真空袋或去掉多余填充物，直接降低抛: Billing uses the larger value. Compress the package dimensions (especially the height), use vacuum bags, or remove redundant filler to directly lower volumetric weight and freight.
